title: Kevin Durant Is a Super Investor. Join the Club, KD.
summary: With all the talk about private equity and Silicon Valley hotshots buying up stakes in sports teams, it seems at least one athlete has turned the tables on those investors and made out big too.  Basketball superstar Kevin Durant has apparently turned a $250,000 venture investment into $60 million, which according to sports business guru Joe Pompliano is “one of the best athlete investments ever (and more money than Durant will make playing in the NBA this season).”  Pompliano says that Durant reaped the windfall as part of  Nvidia  buying Hugging Face, an open-source artificial-intelligence platform used by developers, for $12.9 billion.

title: Estee Lauder vs Nike: One Turnaround Just Proved Itself, the Other Keeps Slipping
summary: Two battered consumer giants both hired new leadership to stop the bleeding, but the turnaround playbooks could not look more different right now. Before adding either to a retirement portfolio, the evidence separating genuine recovery from prolonged hope deserves a hard look.
